Summary: The US-Iran agreement can bring peace to the region with a strong diplomatic follow-up, G7 leaders said in a joint statement. 'We strongly support a robust and comprehensive diplomatic follow-on agreement to the Memorandum of Understanding secured by President Trump that can bring peace and security for all in the region,' the statement said. The statement added that the agreement ‘provides a historic opportunity to prevent Iran from acquiring any nuclear weapon and tackling the threats related to its regional and ballistic activities.’ G7 leaders also called on an ‘immediate robust ceasefire’ in Lebanon and the ‘swift implementation of political and security measures’ in Gaza
